decisions.reason: As a flagship offer tightly aligned with the firm's cloud messaging direction, it is likely to have shown enough strategic value by now that keeping it remains the better option despite some rationalization risk.

After several years a lightly promoted email-fax bridge service has had ample time to reveal its value, and if it is still only a niche offer the firm would likely reallocate resources toward stronger cloud workflow opportunities.
Because this is a close-to-core fax optimization feature with likely low carrying cost, it is still worth keeping to support existing fax-reliant customers while the legacy demand base persists.
Email sandbox threat protection reinforces the firm's secure and compliant communications proposition and likely remains a valuable cross-sell with limited downside to continued availability.

Multi-engine virus scanning still fits the secure messaging stack and is probably inexpensive to maintain, though some overlap with other security products creates a moderate chance of later portfolio simplification.
